title: Study finds Amazon rainforest now releases more carbon than it absorbs
summary_en: A new study in Nature by an international team of researchers, including from the University of Kansas, shows the hotter, drier Amazon is a net source of global carbon emissions.
title_cn: Study finds Amazon rainforest now releases more carbon than it absorbs

title: KU Alumni announces student honorees of 2026 Homecoming awards
summary_en: The 114th University of Kansas Homecoming, sponsored by Central Bank, concluded with a win against Baylor University on Oct. 24. Thirteen Jayhawks were honored with 2026 Homecoming Awards, shining a spotlight on the alumni, students and faculty who embody the very best of Jayhawk pride and tradition.
title_cn: KU Alumni announces student honorees of 2026 Homecoming awards
